subject.title: fix(ollama): bound model pull body reads past idle timeout

question: Should an Ollama setup pull with continuous aggregate `completed` growth remain allowed beyond six hours, or is a six-hour product-wide maximum intentional?
rationale: The patch changes a previously unbounded healthy-transfer path into a hard failure mode; selecting that user-visible compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve advancing pulls
options.body: Apply the absolute cap only while no byte progress exists, so active model downloads retain the established streaming-progress behavior.

options.title: Adopt a six-hour setup limit
options.body: Keep the unconditional cap, document it as an intentional setup limit, and add upgrade-oriented proof for slow advancing pulls.

recommendation.title: Preserve advancing pulls
recommendation.body: Apply the absolute cap only while no byte progress exists, so active model downloads retain the established streaming-progress behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline identifies this handle for review of the timeout contract, while no stronger current-main file-history owner was available in the supplied material.
